inspected_by: assistant (Phase 3.7 visual inspection of the extracted sprites at 2x zoom, cross-checked against the measured rest placement); this is not a person's review

conventions.sprite_axes: x = image right, y = image down, z = toward the viewer (front camera)
conventions.palm_normal_sprite: unit vector out of the palm surface, in the sprite as drawn
conventions.angles: degrees from sprite-down, + toward image left (the rig's 'ang' convention)
conventions.handedness_rule: with fingers f and palm normal n (sprite axes), a right hand has its thumb along f x n, a left hand along n x f
conventions.rotation_tolerance_deg: how far the drawing may be turned in the image plane from how it was drawn before its reading changes (a cup tips, a thumb stops pointing up, relaxed fingers stop hanging). A camera-facing flat hand keeps its palm reading at any angle, so its tolerance is 180

r1c1.cues: re-inspected in Phase 3.8.1: the fingers hang straight and together and the thumb is a short digit at the image-right edge, partly behind the hand outline; no palm-side cue is drawn (the palm drawings of the same sheet, e.g. the open palms and cupped hands, show palm creases). Read as the BACK of a right hand. The Phase 3.7 palm reading as a left hand put the palm toward the camera with the thumb outward on a hanging arm (a fully supinated forearm), which is not a resting hand; the artist's own arms-down front view (references/schoolboy/character_sheet.jpg) shows hanging hands from the back with the thumbs toward the body. Assistant's reading, not a person's review; correct it in the Hand Inspector if the palm reading was intended
r1c1.gesture_semantics: a relaxed hanging hand: the fingers read as hanging under gravity only within about 50 deg of hanging

r1c2.cues: palm creases drawn, thumb sticks out to the image right: the palm of a left hand faces the viewer
r1c2.gesture_semantics: open hand, palm toward the camera, fingers spread

r1c3.cues: curled fingers face the viewer, the thumb wraps across them on the image right
r1c3.gesture_semantics: closed fist seen from the finger side

r1c4.cues: the index points image-left from a wrist on the image right, the thumb is on top and the curled fingers face the viewer: f = -x, n = +z, f x n = +y (up) -> right hand (already flagged at extraction)
r1c4.gesture_semantics: index extended, other fingers curled; aimed by the wrist

r2c1.cues: wrist cut on the image left, curled fingers point image-right and face the viewer, thumb up: f = +x, n = +z, n x f = +y -> left hand
r2c1.gesture_semantics: thumbs-up: reads only while the thumb points up

r2c2.cues: C-shaped grip seen in profile, opening to the image right, wrist side on the image left; a profile view of a left hand and a mirrored right hand look the same, so handedness follows the row group and the outward wrist side
r2c2.gesture_semantics: grip around an object in front of the fingers (contact gesture)

r2c3.cues: back of the hand seen from above, fingers down-right, thumb to the image left (toward the body): n = (0, +0.74, -0.67), f down-right, n x f has a -x component -> left hand
r2c3.gesture_semantics: flat hand resting palm-down on a surface below eye level

r2c4.cues: palm up seen from the front and slightly above (palm creases visible), fingers to the image left curling up, thumb on the far (upper) side, wrist on the image right: f = -x, n = up, f x n points away from the viewer -> the thumb is behind -> right hand. Stored as left_cupped (row group); at rest it is placed 182 deg from how it was drawn on the left arm (every other sideways drawing of the left group is within 4 deg)
r2c4.gesture_semantics: cupped/offering palm-up hand; turned more than about 35 deg the cup tips, turned 180 deg it is palm-down

r3c1.cues: re-inspected in Phase 3.8.1: the fingers hang straight and together and the thumb is a short digit at the image-left edge, partly behind the hand outline; no palm-side cue is drawn (the palm drawings of the same sheet, e.g. the open palms and cupped hands, show palm creases). Read as the BACK of a left hand. The Phase 3.7 palm reading as a right hand put the palm toward the camera with the thumb outward on a hanging arm (a fully supinated forearm), which is not a resting hand; the artist's own arms-down front view (references/schoolboy/character_sheet.jpg) shows hanging hands from the back with the thumbs toward the body. Assistant's reading, not a person's review; correct it in the Hand Inspector if the palm reading was intended

r3c2.gesture_semantics: open hand, palm toward the camera

r3c3.cues: mirror of r1c3: thumb across the curled fingers on the image left
r3c3.gesture_semantics: closed fist seen from the finger side

r3c4.cues: points image-left with the thumb on top and the curled fingers toward the viewer: right hand (the same hand as r1c4)
r3c4.gesture_semantics: index extended; aimed by the wrist

r4c1.cues: mirror of r2c1: wrist cut on the image right, f = -x, n = +z, f x n = +y -> right hand
r4c1.gesture_semantics: thumbs-up: reads only while the thumb points up

r4c2.cues: mirror of r2c2 (profile view: handedness follows the row group and the outward wrist side)
r4c2.gesture_semantics: grip around an object in front of the fingers

r4c3.cues: mirror of r2c3: back of the hand from above, fingers down-left, thumb to the image right (toward the body)

r.cues: the character's own right hand in the T-pose: open palm toward the viewer, fingers outward (image left), thumb up
r.gesture_semantics: open hand, palm toward the camera (reference pixels)

l.cues: the character's own left hand in the T-pose: open palm toward the viewer, fingers outward (image right), thumb up
l.gesture_semantics: open hand, palm toward the camera (reference pixels)

revisions.change: relaxed: palm of a left hand -> back of a right hand

previous.cues: fingers hang down, thumb on the image right; no palm creases are drawn, so the drawing could also read as the back of a right hand. Kept as a camera-facing left palm, consistent with the open palm r1c2 of the same row group
